sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the appellant.
2. This appeal is dismissed in view of the fact that it is not maintainable, as the appeal is valued less than R.1,00,000/-.

However, such dismissal would be without prejudice to the contention taken by appellant in MFA.No.7716/2022 and MFA.No.7737/2022.
Sd/-
